facts.es: Según su perfil de LinkedIn (el que enlaza la web de Metallicus), es cofundador y CTO de Metal desde julio de 2017.
facts.en: According to his LinkedIn profile (the one Metallicus's website links to), he has been co-founder and CTO of Metal since July 2017.

sources.title: LinkedIn – Glenn Mariën (perfil enlazado desde la web de Metallicus)

facts.es: Según su LinkedIn, antes trabajó como desarrollador full-stack en iDA Mediafoundry (enero – noviembre de 2017, Amberes) y como consultor de comercio electrónico Intershop y desarrollador web JEE en Fenego (agosto de 2012 – enero de 2017), donde participó en un proyecto para TomTom (diciembre de 2015 – febrero de 2016).
facts.en: According to his LinkedIn, he previously worked as a full-stack developer at iDA Mediafoundry (January – November 2017, Antwerp) and as an Intershop e-commerce consultant and JEE web developer at Fenego (August 2012 – January 2017), where he worked on a project for TomTom (December 2015 – February 2016).

facts.en: According to his LinkedIn, he holds a Bachelor's in Computer Science from Provinciale Hogeschool Limburg, now PXL (2009–2012).

facts.en: According to his LinkedIn, between June and October 2014 he worked on an "online wallet for a virtual currency" project, which fits with Metallicus crediting him with creating Dogechain.info.

facts.es: En su LinkedIn figura como fundador y CEO de «Blockai (acquired by Pixsy)» de abril de 2013 a junio de 2014, con el lema «Bitcoin Made Simple». La prensa de la época sitúa esas fechas en QuickCoin, que cofundó con Nathan Lands, y Blockai se lanzó en 2016 con Lands como CEO.
facts.en: On his LinkedIn he is listed as founder and CEO of "Blockai (acquired by Pixsy)" from April 2013 to June 2014, with the tagline "Bitcoin Made Simple". Contemporary press places those dates at QuickCoin, which he co-founded with Nathan Lands, and Blockai launched in 2016 with Lands as CEO.

facts.en: The start date also varies on LinkedIn: Marshall Hayner dates his role as founder and CEO of Metallicus to January 2015, while company releases give 2016 or 2017 as the founding year.
